journey.name: MOD-05: 多模态附件上传与管理
journey.description: 验证通过编辑栏的附件加号按钮打开系统选择菜单（拍照、相册选择、SAF文档选择），在编辑栏上方面板呈现附件暂存卡片、上传进度与核验状态，并支持用户移除已选附件。

actions.action: Click the "添加附件" button next to the composer input
Verify that the attachment selection bottom sheet appears
Verify that "拍照" option is visible
Verify that "相册选择" option is visible
Verify that "文档选择" option is visible
Tap outside the attachment selection sheet to dismiss
Verify that the attachment selection sheet is dismissed
Verify that the composer bar remains in a responsive state
